title: The Discover page and domains are now GA
body: The [Discover page](/aws/en/discover/discover-page) and [domains](/aws/en/uc-semantics/domains) are now generally available. Discover is a curated browsing experience that helps users find assets across Databricks without requiring deep knowledge of catalog hierarchies. Use *domains* and *subdomains* to organize assets such as tables, dashboards, notebooks, and Genie Agents by business area, highlight key assets with custom curation, and explore AI-recommended assets.
